senses.gloss: m. (סָבַב; v. מְסִבָּה) reclining; invited guest.
units: Lam. R. to IV, 2 (in Chald. diction) לית את מ׳ thou art not invited.—Pl. מְסוּבִּין guests, dining party.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:2">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> <he>רוב מ׳ של לאה היו אעפ״כ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="L00637"><he>לפיכך</he></cite>) most of the guests (assembled at Boas’ wedding, <cite ref="Ruth 4:11">Ruth IV, 11</cite>) were descendants of Leah, and yet they made Rachel the chief person (placing her before Leah); Ruth R. to l. c.; Pesik. Ronni, p. 141ᵇ (not <he>מסובן</he>); a. e.
